description: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka - Implementation Standards Issued under the Civil Aviation Act. No 14 of 2010
categorisation: This gazette content involves the issuance of implementing standards under the Civil Aviation Act No.14 of 2010, which constitutes regulatory matters and legal frameworks. It contains a detailed schedule of mandatory standards and regulations for civil aviation operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel/structure announcement or other specialized category.
